title.narrative: Improving Solid Waste Management in Windhoek/Namibia

description.narrative: The proposed action will address these needs and constraints of the residents in the CoW by contributing to an integrated urban development, in accordance with the 2030 Agenda on Sustainable Development with a focus on SDGs No. 8, 11 and 12. Additionally, the action will contribute to the reduction of adverse environmental impact per capita of the CoW in relation to municipal waste management. The main result of the proposed action is to enhance capacities of the CoW in managing urban solid wast
